RAFANELLI

Capabilities

Rafanelli Events is an award-winning event company with a proven track record of producing breathtaking events for our clients. Using a combination of creativity, service, design and production, we work closely with all clients to create event concepts and designs that truly represent their unique goals and objectives.

Rafanelli Events has spent more than fifteen years building strong relationships with the best companies across the country and we consistently provide our clients with the most up-to-date technologies and innovations. Our success is built on listening to, respecting, understanding and complementing some of the
most successful people, companies and brands in the world.

Rafanelli Team Twenty-five talented, creative and dedicated professionals Our event teams each consist of CEO Bryan Rafanelli, Creative Director Billy Evers, an Event Producer and a Production Manager.

Types of Events Not-for-Profit, Corporate, Private, Weddings All our clients look to Rafanelli Events for the highest level of quality, detail, innovation and service

Years in Business 15 Years

Events Produced More than 1,200 Events

From small, intimate gatherings to seated dinners for more than 2,000 people, we have produced events in more than 30 cities, 15 states and five countries
